author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't move.

jyutping: mai5 juk1。
text: 咪郁。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It makes little difference to me whether you believe it or not.

jyutping: nei5 seon3 jau6 hou2，m4 seon3 jau6 hou2，deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 mou4 me1 fan1 bit6。
text: 你信又好，唔信又好，對我嚟講無咩分別。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She opened the window to let fresh air into the room.

jyutping: keoi5 daa2 hoi1 zo2 go3 coeng1，dang2 di1 san1 sin1 hung1 hei3 zau2 jap6 gaan1 fong4 dou6。
text: 佢打開咗個窗，等啲新鮮空氣走入間房度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You have to change trains at the next stop.

jyutping: nei5 jiu3 hai2 haa6 jat1 go3 zaam6 dou6 zyun2 ce1。
text: 你要喺下一個站度轉車。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Twelve years old is old for a dog.

jyutping: sap6 ji6 seoi3 deoi3 jat1 zek3 gau2 lai4 gong2 syun3 hai6 hou2 lou5 gaa3 laa3。
text: 十二歲對一隻狗嚟講算係好老㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Who is the person in charge?

jyutping: fu6 zaak3 jan4 hai6 bin1 go3？
text: 負責人係邊個？

author: nickyeow

english.text: When he was leaving, he told me that he would come again by the 25th.

jyutping: keoi5 zau2 go2 zan6 tung4 ngo5 gong2 waa6 jaa6 ng5 hou6 wui5 zoi3 lai4。
text: 佢走嗰陣同我講話廿五號會再嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Since I was thirsty, I drank water.

jyutping: jan1 wai6 ngo5 hou2 geng2 hot3，so2 ji5 ngo5 jam2 zo2 di1 seoi2。
text: 因為我好頸渴，所以我飲咗啲水。

author: fercheung

english.text: There's no one but me here.

jyutping: ni1 dou6 zing6 hai6 dak1 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 ge3 ze1。
text: 呢度淨係得我一個人嘅啫。

author: kaenif

english.text: Smoking is harmful to health.

jyutping: sik6 jin1 deoi3 gin6 hong1 m4 hou2。
text: 食煙對健康唔好。

author: kaenif

english.text: Hold on a second.

jyutping: dang2 ngo5 jat1 zan6。
text: 等我一陣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When was this temple built?

jyutping: ne1 zo6 miu6 hai6 gei2 si4 hei2 gaa3？
text: 呢座廟係幾時起㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He never drinks except on special occasions.

jyutping: keoi5 zing6 hai6 hai2 di1 dak6 bit6 coeng4 hap6 dou3 sin1 wui5 jam2 zau2。
text: 佢淨係喺啲特別場合到先會飲酒。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Come to lunch with us.

jyutping: tung4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 sik6 aan3 laa1。
text: 同我哋一齊食晏啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Our train arrived on time.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaa3 fo2 ce1 zeon2 si4 lai4 dou3。
text: 我哋㗎火車準時嚟到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want to take a nap.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hap6 faan2 zan6。
text: 我想瞌返陣。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can I have a free ride, please? My wallet was stolen.

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 co5 seon6 fung1 ce1 aa3？ngo5 go3 ngan4 baau1 bei2 jan4 tau1 zo2 aa3。
text: 我可唔可以坐順風車呀？我個銀包俾人偷咗呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla is fat and ugly.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 jau6 fei4 jau6 joeng2 seoi1。
text: 蕾拉又肥又樣衰。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This note is better construed as a sharp fifteenth rather than a flat ninth.

jyutping: ni1 go3 jam1 jing1 goi1 nam2 zou6 sharp 15，ji4 m4 hai6 flat 9。
text: 呢個音應該諗做sharp 15，而唔係flat 9。

author: kaenif

english.text: He canceled the appointment at the last moment.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 hak1 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 go3 wui6 min6。
text: 佢喺最後一刻取消咗個會面。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Get a room, you two.

jyutping: maang4 laa3。
text: 盲喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Just because you can, doesn't mean that you should.

jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 gam3 zou6，m4 dang2 jyu1 nei5 jing1 goi1 gam3 zou6。
text: 你可以咁做，唔等於你應該咁做。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The concert drew attendees from the surrounding towns.

jyutping: go3 jam1 ngok6 wui2 kap1 jan5 dou3 hou2 do1 gaak3 lei4 zan3 ge3 jan4 lai4 teng1。
text: 個音樂會吸引到好多隔籬鎮嘅人嚟聽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You should have said no right away.

jyutping: nei5 jing1 goi1 zik1 hak1 keoi5 zyut6 aa1 maa3。
text: 你應該即刻拒絕吖嘛。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: That colour really suits you.

jyutping: ne1 zek3 sik1 can3 saai3 nei5。
text: 呢隻色襯曬你。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: This is too easy for him.

jyutping: ne1 joeng2 deoi3 keoi4 loi4 gong2 sap1 sap1 seoi3。
text: 呢樣對渠來講濕濕碎。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?

jyutping: ni1 dou6 fu6 gan6 on1 m4 on1 cyun4 gaa3？je6 maan5 jau5 mou4 dang1 gaa3？
text: 呢度附近安唔安全㗎？夜晚有無燈㗎？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: The house is pretty.

jyutping: gaan1 uk1 hou2 leng3 gaa3！
text: 間屋好靚㗎！

author: Gearhulk

english.text: I appreciate your efforts to help me.

jyutping: ngo5 hou2 gam2 gik1 nei5 lok6 lik6 bong1 ngo5 sau2。
text: 我好感激你落力幫我手。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I loved Amaryllis. I forgot to eat or to drink; and I could take no rest, for sleep was banished from my eyelids. My soul was sad, my heart beat quick, my limbs felt a deadly chill. Now I wept and cried aloud, as if I had been beaten, now I was as silent as if I were dead, and now I plunged into the rivers, as if to extinguish the flame which consumed me.

jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 aa3 maa5 lei6 lei6 si1。 ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 sik6 ding6 jam2； ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 jau1 sik1，jan1 wai6 seoi6 min4 ji5 ging1 cung4 ngo5 ge3 ngaan5 pei4 soeng6 bei6 keoi1 zuk6 ceot1 heoi3。 ngo5 ge3 ling4 wan4 hou2 soeng1 sam1，ngo5 ge3 sam1 tiu3 dak1 hou2 faai3，ngo5 ge3 sei3 zi1 gam2 gok3 dou3 jat1 zung2 zi3 ming6 ge3 hon4 laang5。 ji4 gaa1 ngo5 haam3 zo2，daai6 seng1 gam2 haam3，hou2 ci5 bei2 jan2 daa2 zo2 gam3，ji4 gaa1 ngo5 hou2 ci5 sei2 zo2 gam3 cam4 mak6，ji4 gaa1 ngo5 cim4 jap6 ho4 lau4，hou2 ci5 soeng2 sik1 mit6 go2 go3 tan1 sai6 ngo5 ge3 fo2 jim6。
text: 我鍾意阿瑪利利斯。 我唔記得食定飲； 我唔可以休息，因為睡眠已經從我嘅眼皮上被驅逐出去。 我嘅靈魂好傷心，我嘅心跳得好快，我嘅四肢感覺到一種致命嘅寒冷。 而家我喊咗，大聲噉喊，好似畀人打咗咁，而家我好似死咗咁沉默，而家我潛入河流，好似想熄滅嗰個吞噬我嘅火焰。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In a Club, though there mayn’t be a soul of your acquaintance in the room, you have always the chance of watching strangers, and speculating on what is going on within those tents and curtains of their souls, their coats and waistcoats. This is a never-failing sport. Indeed I am told there are some Clubs in the town where nobody ever speaks to anybody. They sit in the coffee-room, quite silent, and watching each other.

jyutping: hai2 jat1 go3 Club jap6 min6，seoi1 jin4 fong4 jap6 min6 mei6 bit1 jau5 nei5 suk6 jan4 ge3 ling4 wan4，daan6 nei5 zung2 jau5 gei1 wui6 tai2 zyu6 mak6 sang1 jan4，tung4 maai4 caai1 caak1 keoi5 dei6 ling4 wan4、ngoi6 tou3 tung4 bui3 sam1 ge3 zoeng3 pung4 tung4 coeng1 lim2 jap6 min6 faat3 sang1 gan2 di1 me1 si6。ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 hong6 wing5 jyun5 m4 wui5 sat1 baai6 ge3 wan6 dung6。dik1 kok3，ngo5 teng1 jan4 gong2 zan3 soeng6 jau5 di1 keoi1 lok6 bou6 hai6 mou5 jan4 tung4 jam6 ho4 jan4 gong2 je5 ge3。keoi5 dei6 zo6 hai2 gaa3 fe1 sat1，gei2 zing6，wu6 soeng1 mong6 zyu6 deoi3 fong1。
text: 喺一個 Club 入面，雖然房入面未必有你熟人嘅靈魂，但你總有機會睇住陌生人，同埋猜測佢哋靈魂、外套同背心嘅帳篷同窗簾入面發生緊啲咩事。呢個係一項永遠唔會失敗嘅運動。的確，我聽人講鎮上有啲俱樂部係冇人同任何人講嘢嘅。佢哋坐喺咖啡室，幾靜，互相望住對方。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: If there is anyone out there who still doubts that America is a place where all things are possible, who still wonders if the dream of our founders is alive in our time, who still questions the power of our democracy, tonight is your answer. It's the answer told by lines that stretched around schools and churches in numbers this nation has never seen, by people who waited three hours and four hours, many for the first time in their lives, because they believed that this time must be different, that their voices could be that difference. It's the answer spoken by young and old, rich and poor, Democrat and Republican, black, white, Hispanic, Asian, Native American, gay, straight, disabled and not disabled. Americans who sent a message to the world that we have never been just a collection of individuals or a collection of red states and blue states. We are, and always will be, the United States of America.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 zung6 waai4 ji4 mei5 gwok3 hai6 jat1 go3 jat1 cai3 gaai1 jau5 ho2 nang4 ge3 dei6 fong1，zung6 nam2 gan2 ngo5 dei6 cong3 ci2 jan4 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai2 ngo5 dei6 ne1 go3 si4 doi6 hai6 mai6 zung6 cyun4 zoi6，zung6 zat1 ji4 gan2 ngo5 dei6 man4 zyu2 ge3 lik6 loeng6，gam1 maan1 zau6 hai6 nei5 ge3 daap3 on3，ne1 go3 hai6 jau4 ne1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 cung4 mei6 gin3 gwo3 ge3 hok6 haau6 tung4 gaau3 tong4 zau1 wai4 ge3 sin3 tiu4 gong2 ceot1 lai4 ge3 daap3 on3，jau4 dang2 zo2 saam1 go3 zung1 tau4 tung4 sei3 go3 zung1 tau4 ge3 jan4 gong2 ceot1 lai4，hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hai6 dai6 jat1 ci3 soeng1 seon3，keoi5 dei6 ge3 sing1 jam1 jat1 ding6 hai6 hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 si4 doi6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3。ne1 go3 hai6 jau4 lou5 siu3 haam4 ji4、jau5 cin2 jau5 kung4、man4 zyu2 dong2 tung4 gung6 wo4 dong2、hak1 jan4、baak6 jan4、sai1 baan1 ngaa4 jeoi6、aa3 zau1 jan4、mei5 zau1 jyun4 zyu6 man4、tung4 sing3 lyun2、ji6 sing3 lyun2、caan4 zat6 tung4 fei1 caan4 zat6 mei5 gwok3 jan4 so2 gong2 ge3 daap3 on3，keoi5 dei6 hoeng3 sai3 gaai3 faat3 ceot1 zo2 jat1 go3 seon3 sik1，zik1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 ge3 zaap6 hap6，waak6 ze2 hai6 jat1 go3 hung4 sik1 zau1 tung4 laam4 sik1 zau1 ge3 zaap6 hap6。
text: 如果有人仲懷疑美國係一個一切皆有可能嘅地方，仲諗緊我哋創始人嘅夢想喺我哋呢個時代係咪仲存在，仲質疑緊我哋民主嘅力量，今晚就係你嘅答案，呢個係由呢個國家從未見過嘅學校同教堂周圍嘅線條講出嚟嘅答案，由等咗三個鐘頭同四個鐘頭嘅人講出嚟，好多人都係第一次相信，佢哋嘅聲音一定係喺佢哋嘅時代有唔同嘅。呢個係由老少咸宜、有錢有窮、民主黨同共和黨、黑人、白人、西班牙裔、亞洲人、美洲原住民、同性戀、異性戀、殘疾同非殘疾美國人所講嘅答案，佢哋向世界發出咗一個訊息，即係我哋從來都唔係一個人嘅集合，或者係一個紅色州同藍色州嘅集合。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's nice and hot today, this blue-sky sunny 30th of June of 2025. At Tim Hortons café, I've enjoyed today a Sausage Farmer's Wrap, an Iced Classic Lemonade, an Iced Coffee with oat milk, an Everything Bagel with butter, and a Strawberry Watermelon Sparkling Quencher. Yesterday, I was really remembering Vancouver's Pacific Centre, not the Harbour Centre Mall. Such enclosed shopping malls remind me of potential future colonies on other planets and moons. Maybe, AI will help humanity.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 jau6 hou2 jau6 jit6，ni1 go3 laam4 tin1 cing4 long5 ge3 2025 nin4 6 jyut6 30 hou6。hai2 Tim Hortons café ，ngo5 gam1 jat6 hoeng2 jung6 zo2 hoeng1 coeng2 nung4 fu1 baau1、bing1 dung3 ging1 din2 ning4 mung1 seoi2、bing1 gaa3 fe1 pui3 maai4 jin3 mak6 naai5、jat1 cai3 baak3 gat1 beng2 pui3 ngau4 jau4，tung4 maai4 bui1 cou2 mui2 sai1 gwaa1 hei2 pok1 ceoi3 fo2 zau2。cam4 jat6，ngo5 zan1 hai6 gei3 dak1 wan1 go1 waa4 ge3 taai3 ping4 joeng4 zung1 sam1，ji4 m4 hai6 hoi2 gong2 zung1 sam1 soeng1 coeng4。ni1 di1 fung1 bai3 ge3 soeng1 coeng4 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2 mei6 loi4 kei4 taa1 haang4 sing1 tung4 jyut6 kau4 soeng6 ge3 cim4 zoi6 zik6 man4 dei6。ho2 nang4，jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 wui5 bong1 zo6 jan4 leoi6。
text: 今日天氣又好又熱，呢個藍天晴朗嘅2025年6月30號。喺 Tim Hortons café ，我今日享用咗香腸農夫包、冰凍經典檸檬水、冰咖啡配埋燕麥奶、一切百吉餅配牛油，同埋杯草莓西瓜起泡淬火酒。尋日，我真係記得溫哥華嘅太平洋中心，而唔係海港中心商場。呢啲封閉嘅商場令我諗起未來其他行星同月球上嘅潛在殖民地。可能，人工智能會幫助人類。
